toolProjects.name: Chronicle.Tools.PackageValidator
toolProjects.purpose: Validate Rule Set manifests, artifacts, evidence families, fingerprints, and promotion readiness.
forbiddenDependencies: executing untrusted arbitrary package code without security review

Initial implementation accepts one explicit package-source path, invokes the canonical package-source validator, and performs no discovery, loading, execution, installation, publication, or mutation.
